canonical_capture_law: Every future tide stores all provider-advertised raw HTTP event fields with time bounds only; no semantic traffic filter is permitted.
public_law: Canonical raw traffic captures are ordinary public Crawlerbait Traces in this public repository and are linked from /crawlerbait/traffic.json.
bootstrap_law: When the raw cursor is uninitialized, capture begins at the live provider retention boundary and freezes everything still available before advancing incrementally.

legacy_404_evidence.law: Preserve as partial historical 404 evidence only. Never extend it and never mix its counts with canonical raw-request counts.
